This function uses a dictionary to map the full English weekday names to their corresponding integers. Based on common computer science introductory exercises (where Sunday is often 0), the mapping uses Sunday = 0 through Saturday = 6. It also handles variations in capitalization by title-casing the input.

Confidence level: 100%

```python
def day_number(day_name):
    days = {
        "Sunday": 0,
        "Monday": 1,
        "Tuesday": 2,
        "Wednesday": 3,
        "Thursday": 4,
        "Friday": 5,
        "Saturday": 6
    }
    return days.get(day_name.strip().title())
```
